_comment: Episodes of the Brief's own show, newest first. scripts/build_podcast.py REWRITES this file when SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID / SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET are set — set those (free app at developer.spotify.com/dashboard) and every episode appears automatically. Until then this is hand-maintained: add {title, url, date, blurb} and it shows up. Only the newest episode is seeded here because it is the only one Spotify exposes publicly — the show is not on Apple Podcasts, beehiiv, or the YouTube channel, all checked.
